item.description:
0.7.1

Fixes from the first real board.

  • Text transfer sent its commands too fast for the device's shell, which read them as fragments. Each step now waits for the device to echo back before the next one goes.
  • Waiting for a device that never answers no longer looks like a hang. The progress sheet appears only once bytes move, so the terminal stays usable and you can still start the receiver on the device.
  • The protocol menu no longer clips, and the hint says what to do first.
